$comment: The sample lifts (plan 5.2). Each clip's source, licence and credit are in SOURCES.md. LookieBot checks them before phase 1 merges. `meet`: the stored command times the demo meet uses when a sample lift stands in for a filmed attempt (5.36), and `reps`, the reps in the clip: a sample standing in for a Home attempt is judged on them. The good and no lifts start on "Squat!"; the close call 0.9 s before it. tests/unit/samples-meet.test.ts checks the server's judge calls each one as its kind.
